# The PMFA Journal

> A comprehensive peer-reviewed publication covering plastic surgery, aesthetic medicine, dermatology, and facial plastic surgery with clinical education, research updates, and industry news.

The PMFA Journal is the official publication of the PMFA (Plastic, Maxillofacial and Aesthetic Association) based in the UK, providing clinical guidance, case reports, surgical techniques, and professional development resources for aesthetic and plastic surgery practitioners.

## Key Topics

- Aesthetic Medicine
- Plastic Surgery
- Dermatology
- Facial Plastic Surgery
- Clinical Research
- Surgical Techniques
- Cosmetic Procedures
- Medical Aesthetics
- Case Reports
- Clinical Practice
- PMFA Association
- Merz Aesthetics
- Digital Twin Technology
- Medico-legal Guidance

## Core Navigation

- [Homepage](https://www.thepmfajournal.com): Homepage for The PMFA Journal covering plastic surgery and aesthetic medicine
- [Features](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/features): Features overview page for The PMFA Journal navigation and information
- [Education](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/education): Education section with publication guidelines and journal resources
- [Events](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/events): Medical conferences and professional development events calendar

## Clinical Education & Techniques

- [How I Do It](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/education/how-i-do-it): Surgical technique guides for burn treatment, skin grafting, and procedures
- [Case Reports](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/education/case-reports): Clinical case reports in aesthetic medicine, dermatology, and facial surgery
- [Features](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/features/features): Clinical features and peer-reviewed articles on aesthetic medicine topics
- [Medico-legal Forum](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/education/medico-legal-forum): Medico-legal guidance on expert witnesses and professional ethics

## Content & Research

- [Interviews](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/features/interviews): Interviews with medical professionals in plastic surgery and dermatology
- [Research Update](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/research-update): Research updates and academic publication summaries for PMFA
- [Journal Reviews](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/research-update/journal-reviews): Summaries of plastic surgery and dermatology journal articles
- [Book Reviews](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/research-update/book-reviews): Book reviews on aesthetic medicine and clinical practice topics

## News & Industry Updates

- [Industry News](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/industry-news): Industry news on aesthetic products, clinical research, and innovations
- [News](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/news): Healthcare news covering NHS, surgery, and clinical practice updates
- [Malignant melanoma, stress and cosmetic surgery](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/features/features/post/malignant-melanoma-stress-and-cosmetic-surgery): Article on melanoma, stress response, and cosmetic surgery complications
- [BTL EXOMIND publishes a new clinical paper](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/industry-news/post/btl-exomind-publishes-a-new-clinical-paper): Clinical research publication on ExoTMS technology for mental wellness
- [Aura: Redefining Precision in Aesthetic Consultations through Digital Twin Technology](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/industry-news/post/aura-redefining-precision-in-aesthetic-consultations-through-digital-twin-technology): Article on Aura's digital twin 3D imaging technology for aesthetic consultations
- [ACRE officially appointed distribution partner for Merz Aesthetics brands](https://www.thepmfajournal.com/industry-news/post/acre-officially-appointed-distribution-partner-for-merz-aesthetics-brands): Business announcement of ACRE as distributor for Merz Aesthetics products
